name: diffusion
description: A video editor inside each harness project. Films belong to that project. Agents use the same commands; sign-in, generation, transcription and listen go through local adapters.

tools.name: diffusion.run
tools.description: Run one editor command in the film open in the project's video tab: open, context, capture, check, export, probe, grab, transcribe, filmstrip, waveform, listen, fonts, logs, screenshot, window, job.

tools.name: diffusion.film
tools.description: Create a film in this chat's project. Its files live in _inbox/assets/<name>.

tools.name: diffusion.source
tools.description: Read or replace the open film's index.tsx, or copy a chat-project file into the film library. Library files are copied to _inbox/assets/<film name>.

tools.name: diffusion.generate
tools.description: Generate media through the connected adapter. Without an address the call says nothing is connected.
